description: Na₆V₄Mn₂O₁₅ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-3.02 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.61 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.92 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-46°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.77 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-24°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.81 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.32 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na, one V, and one Mn atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄MnV octahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two equivalent V atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one Mn atom.
